network.note: Loopback server: no network latency or bandwidth limit.

cache_policy.deployment: publish complete generation before index; retain old generations for open clients

conditions.cold: new browser process and profile per run (empty HTTP and code caches)
conditions.warm: one browser profile primed by an unreported first load; each run is a new document

clock.origin_definition: performance.now() when the export index.html head runs, before any module loads; performance.now() itself counts from navigation start (performance.timeOrigin).
clock.host_clock: main-thread performance.now(); worker clocks are not mixed in

instrumentation: Timing wrappers on WebAssembly.instantiateStreaming/instantiate/compileStreaming/compile and FontFace.prototype.load (results unchanged)
DevTools protocol Page/Runtime/Network domains; Performance.getMetrics once per run
one player-accessor poll every 100 ms between the first submission and the last awaited milestone

profile.coverage_note: A bounded ring: overwritten records stay counted, so retained events alone are not continuous coverage.

notes: Times are milliseconds relative to window.playerBoot unless a field says otherwise; navigation.* fields are relative to navigation start, and boot_ms is playerBoot itself.

summary.* quantiles are taken across runs of one kind, per metric; they are never added to one another. A within-run image or frame value (images.*_max, frames.*_p95_ms) is one number per run, summarized like any other.
p95 is nearest-rank: with five runs it equals the slowest run.

null means the browser or this player did not expose the value; it is never zero by assumption. transfer_bytes is null when the browser hides sizes (cross-origin without Timing-Allow-Origin, opaque origins); cache comes from the browser network log, not from transferSize.
Profiler-on runs are diagnostics for locating costs; compare profiler-off runs for acceptance.
Emulated network and CPU throttling are not a real device or radio network.
evidence_note: Validation run of scripts/measure-web-export.mjs on an exported starter project, 2026-11-15, one desktop machine. Starter numbers only: not GodOfWar, not a phone, not a target. The starter adds api.profile.mark("starter.interactive") on its first update.
